title_sq: Ofrojme apartament 2+1 per shitje tek Kompleksi Univers City.
description_sq:
Ofrojme apartament 2+1 per shitje tek Kompleksi Univers City.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e tete. te fundit te nje proj objekteve te Riviera 2008, ne fazen finale te punimeve dhe ne proces dorzimi.
Organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje me ambjent gatimi, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete , korridor shperndares dhe ballkon ne gjithe perimetrin e apartamentit me orientim lindje.
Mundesi pershtatje ne apartament 3+1.
Per me teper informacion me kontaktoni.
title_en: We offer a 2+1 apartment for sale at Univers City Complex.
description_en: We offer a 2+1 apartment for sale at Univers City Complex. The apartment is located on the eighth floor. the last of one of the objects of Riviera 2008, in the final phase of the works and in the process of delivery. It is organized in a living room with a kitchen area, two bedrooms, two toilets, a distribution corridor and a balcony around the entire perimeter of the apartment facing east. Possibility of adaptation in apartment 3+1. For more information, contact me.
